Let\'s set up your phone.

%1$s uses Taptime to record your shifts. Each tap saves the time, your phone\'s IP address and, if your phone shares it, your location at that moment. Your location is never tracked between taps. No finger scans, no face, no voice.
This is a new phone

Terms and privacy
Who is responsible
%1$s is responsible for your attendance records. Taptime processes them on its behalf.
What is recorded

The time of each tap, the venue, your phone\'s IP address and, if your phone shares it, your location at that moment. A key kept on this phone keeps it signed in, so you don\'t need a password. Your location is never tracked between taps. No finger scans, no face, no voice.

To record your working hours for %1$s
